scripts.build: vite build && node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => { fs.copyFileSync('manifest.json', 'dist/manifest.json'); fs.mkdirSync('content', { recursive: true }); fs.mkdirSync('worker', { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync('dist/content/index.js', 'content/index.js'); fs.copyFileSync('dist/worker/index.js', 'worker/index.js'); })"
